nodes.label: Flow dialect
nodes.desc: First IR layer: partitions the input program into dispatchable workgroups and tracks tensor residency.

nodes.label: Stream dialect
nodes.desc: Second layer: turns dispatch partitions into async streams with explicit allocations, fences, and copies.

nodes.label: HAL dialect
nodes.desc: Third layer: hardware abstraction ops for devices, command buffers, and executables that the runtime implements.

nodes.label: VM dialect
nodes.desc: Fourth layer: the serializable virtual machine ops (funcs, calls, registers) hosting all control flow.

nodes.label: compiler pipelines
nodes.desc: Orchestrates the whole compile: input processing, then Flow/Stream/HAL/VM transformation stages in order.

nodes.label: HAL transforms
nodes.desc: Materializes device selection, interfaces, and executable variants; hands dispatches to per-backend codegen.

nodes.label: target registry
nodes.desc: Maps target names (llvm-cpu, cuda, hip, metal, vulkan) to TargetBackend codegen plugins.

nodes.label: driver registry
nodes.desc: Runtime-side factory registry: statically registered driver factories enumerate and create devices by name.

nodes.label: HIP driver
nodes.desc: AMD HIP runtime driver: enumerates GPUs, creates devices, and manages streams and events.

nodes.label: executable cache
nodes.desc: Prepares compiled executables per device format, with caching so binaries load without recompiling.

nodes.label: bytecode module
nodes.desc: Loads the serialized VM flatbuffer archive, verifies it, and exposes functions to the VM context.

nodes.label: iree-run-module
nodes.desc: Reference CLI: creates a session, loads a .vmfb, feeds inputs, and prints outputs.
